articles.title: Soccer Fever! The World Cup Kicks Off Tomorrow—Here's Your Cheat Sheet
articles.summary: The 2026 FIFA World Cup starts June 11 with Mexico vs. South Africa. For the first time, 48 teams will battle it out across North America. The U.S. plays Paraguay on Friday at 9 p.m. ET.

articles.title: Big Student Loan Changes Are Coming July 1—Are You Ready?
articles.summary: Starting July 1, new rules from the One Big Beautiful Bill Act will change student loan repayment plans and borrowing limits. Over 7 million borrowers must switch from the SAVE plan. Grad students face new caps.

articles.title: Prices Are Soaring: Why Everything Costs More Right Now
articles.summary: U.S. inflation hit 4.2% in May, the highest in three years. Gas prices jumped 40% from last year to $4.15 a gallon. Rising energy costs are squeezing families, and the Fed might raise interest rates.
